name: thepapers-niw
description: U.S. EB-2 National Interest Waiver (NIW) skills for DIY self-petitioners and immigration professionals. niw-evaluate gives an honest pre-filing assessment under the Dhanasar three-prong framework. niw-package-review reads an assembled package as a skeptical adjudicator would, tests each prong against preponderance on documented evidence only, quotes the petition passages that overclaim, and returns a prioritized fix list and a readiness verdict. Legal substance is published in knowledge/ and distilled from the complete public pool of 1,040 AAO non-precedent NIW decisions issued 2025-01 through 2026-06. Future skills will cover endeavor-statement drafting, national-importance evidence research, recommendation letters, petition letter drafting, and RFE/NOID response.
